blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs). However, Mix-RL suffers from two critical bottlenecks: the reward sparsity induced by outcome rewards, and the cross-domain interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous capabilities, which together give rise to imbalanced capability acquisition and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in multi-domain capability integration, we introduce RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. First, we cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via single-domain GRPO fine-tuning, allowing each expert to reach its performance ceiling in isolation; then we consolidate these teachers into one student model through (i) routed on-policy distillation, which provides dense signed token-level supervision on student-generated critiques; (ii) domain contribution reweighting, which reweights token guidance toward target domain shares, preventing specific domains from dominating optimization; and (iii) optional criteria context distillation, which conditions teachers on domain-specific evaluation criteria to sharpen token-level supervision. Across multiple RM benchmarks and two base models, RM-OPD consistently outperforms vanilla Mix-RL and other strong baselines, achieving overall superior performance and exhibiting an emergent "teacher-surpassing" effect. These results establish RM-OPD as a promising paradigm for building generalist GRMs.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generative reward models (GRMs) have emerged as a powerful approach to enhance the general capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by providing robust and more reliable reward signals ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Mahan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Unlike traditional scalar reward models that compress evaluation into a numerical score, GRMs generate natural-language rationales with detailed critiques before issuing a final judgment, leading to significantly higher robustness, interpretability, and generalizability through explicit reasoning ( Ankner et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yu et al., 2025b ) . These advantages become particularly important in general-domain reward modeling, as the evaluation criteria for rewards are more diverse and complex, and explicit references or ground-truth are often unavailable ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . Generalist reward modeling is thus crucial for improving the performance of LLMs across broader applications. However, building such a generalist GRM requires distinct evaluation capabilities demanded by different domains: mathematics requires step-level logical verification, code requires reasoning about functional correctness and edge cases, and safety requires intent-sensitive judgment and calibrated refusal ( Lambert et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . The central challenge is therefore to consolidate these heterogeneous evaluation capabilities into a single GRM while enabling them to coexist without mutual degradation.
blocks.zh: 基因奖励模型(GRMS)已作为一种强有力的方法出现,通过提供强而更可靠的奖励信号来增强大语言模型(LLMS)的一般能力(Zhang等,2025a;Mahan等,2024;Chen等,2026). 与将评价压缩成数值分数的传统分级奖励模式不同的是,GRMs在发布最终判决前产生带有详细批评的自然语言理由,通过明确推理导致强性,可解释性和通俗性显著提高(Ankner等,2024;Zhang等,2025a;Yu等,2025b.). 这些优势在一般领域奖励模式中变得尤为重要,因为奖励的评价标准更加多样和复杂,而且往往没有明确的参考或地面真相(Liu等人,2025年b) 。 。 。 。 因此,一般奖励模式的制定对于改进各种应用的有限责任管理软件的业绩至关重要。 然而,建立这样一个通用的GRM需要不同领域所要求的不同评价能力:数学需要一级逻辑核查,代码需要功能正确性和边缘案例的推理,安全需要注意意图的判断和校准拒绝(Lambert等,2025;Liu等,2025a; 周等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 因此,主要的挑战是将这些不同的评价能力合并为一个单一的全球监测机制,同时使它们能够共存而不相互退化。

blocks.en: A prevailing solution for building generalist GRMs is reinforcement learning on mixed multi-domain data (Mix-RL), typically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , which pools prompts from various domains and optimizes one shared policy against a joint objective. Although Mix-RL improves overall performance of GRMs in multi-domain scenarios, they still fail to reach the performance ceiling of single-domain RL. As different tasks demand heterogeneous evaluation capabilities, sparse outcome rewards lack the granularity to harmonize these cross-domain interference, inducing a ”seesaw effect” where optimizing specific reasoning ability (e.g., safety guard) inevitably degrades helpful reasoning like logical verification, limiting the coexistence of multi-domain capabilities ( Standley et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . Figure 1 demonstrates the gap between Mix-RL and independently trained specialists. This dilemma necessitates a shift to dense, trajectory-level reward signals to provide decoupled domain-specific supervision.
blocks.zh: 构建通论性GRM的主要解决方案是在混合多领域数据(Mix-RL)上进行强化学习,一般是群体相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等,2024;Chen等,2026;Liu等,2025b),它汇集了多个领域,并优化了针对共同目标的共享政策. 虽然Mix-RL在多域场景中能改善GRM的整体性能,但仍未能达到单域RL的性能上限. 由于不同的任务需要不同的评价能力,很少的结果奖励缺乏调和这些跨域干扰的颗粒性,诱发一种“锯道效应”,优化特定推理能力(例如安全警卫)不可避免地会降低逻辑核查等有益的推理,限制了多域能力的共存(Standley等,2020;Yu等,2020;Lightman等,2024;Wang等,2026a;Ma等,2026)。 图1显示了Mix-RL和独立培训的专家之间的差距。 这种两难处境要求向密集的、轨迹级的奖励信号转变,以提供与具体域无关的监督。

blocks.en:
Recent successes of on-policy distillation (OPD) in multi-domain LLM post-training suggest a
different paradigm. OPD consolidates heterogeneous capabilities from independently trained specialists into one student model through dense token-level supervision on the student’s own rollouts, which is widely adopted in frontier models ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Xiaomi, 2026 ; GLM, 2026 ) . On-policy context distillation further shows that a context-conditioned teacher can supervise the student’s own trajectories, enabling explicit contextual knowledge or behavioral criteria to be internalized in the student’s parameters ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) . Together, these developments raise a pivotal question for GRMs: Can OPD be adapted to consolidate domain-specialized reward teachers into one generalist GRM while attaining the comparable multi-domain evaluation capability?
blocks.zh:
近期在多领域LLM培训后的政策提炼成功表明:
不同的模式。 OPD通过密集的符号级监督,将独立培训的专家的各种能力整合为一个学生模式,该模式在前沿模式中被广泛采用(Agarwal等,2024;Gu等,2024;Ma等,2026;DeepSeek-AI,2026;Xiaomi,2026;GLM,2026)。 政策背景提炼进一步表明,有环境条件的教师可以监督学生自己的轨迹,使得明确的背景知识或行为标准能够在学生参数中被内化(Ye等,2026;赵等,2026;Hübotter等,2026.). 这些事态发展共同为全球监测机制提出了关键问题: 能否调整业务发展办公室,将专业奖励教师整合为一个通用的GRM,同时达到可比的多领域评价能力?

blocks.en: To address this question, we introduce RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. In the first stage, independent single-domain GRPO training produces domain-specialized reward teachers, allowing each capability to develop without cross-domain interference. In the second stage, RM-OPD consolidates these teachers into one student model through three coordinated components: (1) routed on-policy distillation , which sends each student-generated critique to its matched teacher and converts teacher–student log-probability differences into dense signed token-level supervision; (2) domain contribution reweighting (DCR) , which aligns each domain’s update share with its target allocation and prevents any domain from dominating optimization; and (3) optional criteria context distillation (CCD) , which conditions teachers on domain-specific evaluation criteria to sharpen token-level supervision. Together, these components replace joint sparse-reward optimization with routed dense supervision that integrates diverse evaluation capabilities into one generalist GRM.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了RM-OPD(通过On-Policy Displayation提供奖励模型),这是一个将专家获取与能力整合分开的两阶段框架。 在第一阶段,独立的单域GRPO培训产生域-专用奖励教师,使每个能力都能在不受跨域干扰的情况下得到发展. 在第二阶段,RM-OPD通过三个协调部分将这些教师整合为一个学生模式:(1) 引导政策分解,将每个学生产生的批评寄给与之对应的教师,并将教师-学生的日志概率差异转化为密集的签名符号级别监督;(2) 域贡献再加权(DCR),将每个域的更新份额与其目标分配一致并阻止任何域主导优化;(3) 可选标准上下文分解(CCD),将特定域评价标准作为教师加强符号级别监督的条件。 这些组成部分共同取代了联合的微弱回报优化,取而代之的是路由式密集监管,将不同的评价能力整合到一个通用的GRM中去.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Performance Comparison in Multi-domain Training. (a) On RM-Bench Math, RM-OPD converges substantially faster than both the specialist RL teacher and Mix-RL, rapidly reaching and even surpassing the specialist-teacher level. In contrast, Mix-RL converges more slowly and saturates at a noticeably lower performance level. (b) Across Safety, Math, and Code, RM-OPD consistently outperforms Mix-RL while closely matching or even exceeding the corresponding specialist teachers, demonstrating that RM-OPD effectively consolidates domain-specific capabilities into a single model without the performance trade-offs of Mix-RL.

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the faster convergence and stronger capability coexistence achieved by RM-OPD . Across eight benchmarks and two base families, RM-OPD consistently improves the macro average over matched Mix-RL by by 4.60–5.55% relative. Our contributions are threefold: • Limitation analysis of Mixed-domain RL. We identify two structural limitations of Mix-RL for building generalist GRMs as cross-domain interference and sparse outcome rewards—and show that Mix-RL leaves a consistent performance gap to independently trained specialists. • The RM-OPD framework. We introduce RM-OPD, a two-stage framework that combines task-routed on-policy distillation, domain contribution reweighting, and domain-specific criteria context distillation to integrate specialized evaluation capabilities into one consolidated GRM. • Strong Performance and Generalization. Through extensive experiments across multiple RM benchmarks and two base models, we demonstrate that RM-OPD achieves consistent improvements over vanilla Mix-RL and even surpasses specialized teachers in some domain, exhibiting higher multi-domain performance ceiling and robust out-of-domain generalization capabilities.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Generative reward models (GenRMs) cast preference evaluation as autoregressive next-token prediction, producing rubrics, critiques, and verdicts in natural language ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Mahan et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025c ) . To improve judgment quality beyond supervised fine-tuning, recent work applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to optimize GenRMs against verdict correctness, exemplified by GRPO on chain-of-rubrics judgments ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , rule-based RL with inference-time voting ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , and rationale-augmented variants ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Yu et al., 2025b ) . However, such RLVR-based training relies on sparse verdict-only rewards and a single generalist judge, which struggle to supervise intermediate reasoning tokens and to reconcile heterogeneous domain criteria ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . RM-OPD instead delivers dense token-level supervision from domain-specialized experts on the student’s own judgment rollouts.
blocks.zh: 基因奖励模型(GenRMs)将偏好评价投射为自相递减的下接相接预测,产生自然语言的面值,批评和判断(Ye等,2024;张等,2025a;Mahan等,2024;郑等,2023;Yu等,2025c.). 为了在监督微调之外提高判断质量,最近的工作采用可核查奖励的强化学习方法(RLVR),以优化GENRMs与判决正确性,例如关于Rubrics链判断的GRPO(Chen等,2026年),基于规则的RL与推论时间的投票(Liu等,2025年b),以及理由强化的变体(Wang等,2026年b;Wang等,2026年a;Yu等,2025b)。 然而,这种基于RLVR的培训依赖于很少的只有判决的奖励和单一的通才法官,他们努力监督中间推理标志并调和不同的领域标准(Wang等人,2026b; Wang et al., 2026a). RM-OPD转而提供域内专业专家对学生自身判决推出的密集符号级监督.

blocks.en: Unlike classical offline distillation that suffers from distribution shifts and exposure bias ( Kim and Rush, 2016 ) , on-policy distillation (OPD) optimizes the student over its own generated rollouts, guided by teacher-scored log-probabilities ( Li et al., 2026 ) . This paradigm has proven effective in the LLM domain through reverse-KL and policy-gradient formulations ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) , KL-constrained RL unification ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , and efficiency-oriented variants ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . The paradigm has since been extended to multi-teacher routing ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , flow-matching generators ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , speculative drafters ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , and self-evaluation ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Despite this progress, to the best of our knowledge, no prior work has systematically applied OPD to reward modeling. RM-OPD fills this gap as the first multi-teacher OPD framework for generative reward models, consolidating domain-specialized experts into a single generalist GRM.

(Kang等,2026年) (中文(简体) ). 该范式从此被扩展至多教师路线(马等,2026;高等,2026),流相相发电机(方等,2026),投机起草人(李等,2026),自评(张等,2026. 尽管取得了这些进展,但据我们所知,以前的工作没有系统地将OPD用于奖励模特。 RM-OPD填补了这一空白,成为基因奖励模型的第一个多教师OPD框架,将域专业专家整合为单一通论GRM.

To mitigate distribution shift, on-policy distillation (OPD) performs this alignment on student-generated trajectories, obtaining teacher feedback at prefixes encountered during autoregressive generation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . For generative reward models, the student r θ r_{\theta} generates j ∼ r θ ( ⋅ ∣ z ) j\sim r_{\theta}(\cdot\mid z) , while a frozen teacher r T r_{T} evaluates the same judgment prefixes. blocks.en: RL algorithms, typically GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , enable LLMs to learn domain-specific judgment skills through online exploration under a consistent reward. Trained in isolation, the mathematics, code, and safety teachers each attain a distinct per-domain performance ceiling, establishing the capability yardstick on their matched RM-Bench domains (Figure 1 ). blocks.en: 4.2 How to raise the coexistence ceiling?
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 如何提高共存天花板?

blocks.en: The analysis above identifies the supervision needed to raise the coexistence ceiling. Raising the coexistence ceiling requires supervision that is on-policy , covering states induced by the current student; domain-specific , preserving coherent evaluation criteria; and process-dense , reaching the critique rather than only the final verdict.
blocks.zh: 上述分析确定了提高共存上限所需的监督。 提高共存的上限需要政策监督,包括当前学生所引导的状态;针对具体领域,保持一致的评价标准;以及过程敏锐,作出批评,而不仅仅是最后裁决。

blocks.en: OPD matches these requirements by sampling trajectories from the current student and evaluating teacher distributions at the visited prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . It preserves on-policy exploration while replacing outcome rewards with token-level guidance over the judgment trajectory. Independent domain experts can therefore provide coherent supervision without directly mixing their sparse rewards.
blocks.zh: OPD通过取样当前学生的轨迹和评价访问前缀的教师分布来配合这些要求(Agarwal等,2024;Gu等,2024)。 它保持政策上的探索,同时以象征性的判断轨迹指导取代结果奖励。 因此,独立领域专家可以提供协调一致的监督,而不直接混合其微薄的回报。

blocks.en: This correspondence raises our central question: can OPD consolidate the distinct judgment capabilities of domain-specialized reward teachers into one generalist GRM? We answer this question with RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates domain expertise acquisition from capability integration.
blocks.zh: 这份函文提出了我们的中心问题:OPD能否将域专业奖励教师的独特判断能力整合为一个通论GRM? 我们用RM-OPD(通过On-Political Dispiration提供奖励模型)来回答这个问题,这是一个将域专长的获取与能力整合分开的两阶段框架.

blocks.en: 5 RM-OPD
blocks.zh: 5个RM-OPD

blocks.en: RM-OPD separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. Independently trained reward teachers supervise a shared student on its own judgment trajectories. Routing determines the expert distribution for each input, domain contribution reweighting sets the coefficients of domain-wise token losses, and criteria context distillation conditions the expert on explicit evaluation principles. Together, these components define the supervision used to consolidate domain expertise into one GRM (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: RM-OPD将专家获取与能力整合区分开来. 受过独立培训的奖励教师监督一个共用学生的判断轨迹。 routing决定了每项输入的专家分布,域贡献再加权设定了域标值损失的系数,标准上下文分馏为专家提供了明确评价原则的条件. 这些部分共同界定了用于将域内专门知识整合为一个GRM(图2)的监督。

Each student-generated judgment receives token-level supervision from its domain teacher, conditioned on evaluation criteria. Domain contribution reweighting assigns target coefficients to domain token-mean losses within each micro-batch. The teachers jointly supervise one student, which performs multi-domain judgment at deployment.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6个实验

blocks.en: To evaluate how effectively RM-OPD consolidates heterogeneous evaluation capabilities into a single GRM, we conduct experiments across three distinct domains: safety, mathematics, and code. These domains require distinct evaluation criteria (intent-sensitive judgment, step-level logical verification, and execution-grounded edge-case analysis), providing a rigorous testbed for assessing cross-domain capability integration. By benchmarking RM-OPD against independently trained domain specialists, standard Mix-RL, and strong open-source GRMs, we aim to demonstrate its capacity to mitigate multi-domain performance trade-offs and improve capability coexistence.
blocks.zh: 为了评价RM-OPD如何有效地将不同的评价能力整合到一个单一的GRM中,我们进行了三个不同领域的实验:安全、数学和代码。 这些领域需要不同的评价标准(对判断有灵敏度、分步进行逻辑核查、以及基于执行的边缘案例分析),为评估跨领域能力整合提供了一个严格的测试床。 通过将RM-OPD与受过独立培训的领域专家、标准Mix-RL和强大的开源GRM进行比对,我们的目标是展示其减轻多领域业绩取舍和改善能力共存的能力。

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Our training corpus contains 74k cleaned pairwise preferences, organized into mathematics, code, and safety datasets. The three domain datasets are constructed primarily from the source corpora used by RM-NLHF ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , together with Themis-CodePreference ( Paul et al., 2026 ) ; their full composition is provided in Appendix B.2 . For both Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B ( Guo et al., 2025a ) , we first train one domain-specialized reward teacher on each dataset using single-domain GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . We then concatenate and shuffle the three datasets into a common mixed-domain training pool shared by RM-OPD and MixRL-GRPO. Training is performed on 2 nodes with 8 NVIDIA H800 GPUs each, while evaluation uses a single 8-GPU H800 node.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练大纲包含74克的纯净双向偏好,分为数学、密码和安全数据集。 这三个域名数据集主要由RM-NLHF(Wang等,2026b.)使用的源代码构建而来,并配有"Themis-CodePreference". (Paul等,2026;其全部组成见附录B.2.)。 对于Quen2.5-7B-Instructiont(杨等,2024年)和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B(郭等,2025a年),我们首先使用单域GRPO在每个数据集培训1名域专业奖励教师(邵等,2024年). 然后,我们把三个数据集合并并洗涤成一个由RM-OPD和MixRL-GRPO共享的共同混合域训练池. 培训在2个节点上进行,每个节点有8个NVIDIA H800 GPU,而评价则使用1个8-GPU H800节点.

blocks.en: We evaluate RM-OPD against four categories of baselines: (1) Base Models: the prompted backbone models prior to reward-specific fine-tuning; (2) Domain-Specialized RL Teachers: models trained exclusively on a single domain via GRPO, establishing the in-domain capability ceiling; (3) Mix-RL (MixRL-GRPO): a generalist GRM optimized via joint GRPO on the combined multi-domain dataset, representing the prevailing capability integration paradigm; and (4) Existing Open-Source GRMs: a broad set of strong public reward models, including JudgeLRM ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , CompassJudger-2 ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , RISE-Judge ( Yu et al., 2025a ) , RM-NLHF ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , RM-R1 ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and RRM ( Guo et al., 2025b ) . Our evaluation spans eight public benchmark suites and 16 domain-specific subsets. Appendix B provides the full data composition, training configuration, baseline specifications, and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们对照以下四类基线评估风险管理-业务发展: (1)基建模式:在奖励特定微调前所激发的骨干模型; (2)域外专业RL教师:通过GRPO专门培训单一领域的模型,建立域内能力上限; (3)Mix-RL(MixRL-GRPO):通过联合GRPO对多领域综合数据集进行通用GRM优化,代表了普遍的能力整合范式; (4)现有开放源代码GRM:一套广泛的公众奖励模型,包括法官LRRRM(陈等,2025年),CompassJudger-2(张等,2025年b),RISE-Judge(于等,2025a),RM-NLHF(王等,2026b),RM-R1(陈等,2026年)和RM(郭等,2025b). 我们的评价涉及8个公共基准套件和16个特定领域子集。 附 录 B提供了完整的数据组成、培训配置、基线规格和评价规程。

blocks.en: 6.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要成果

blocks.en: RM-OPD mitigates the performance limitations of Mix-RL. A common bottleneck in multi-domain GRMs is that Mix-RL typically underperforms independently trained specialists due to gradient conflicts (the seesaw effect). Our results demonstrate that RM-OPD effectively addresses this issue. Across both Qwen2.5 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill bases, MixRL-GRPO consistently lags behind the single-domain RL Teachers (e.g., showing noticeable gaps on RewardBench 2 and JudgeBench). In contrast, RM-OPD reliably matches the teachers or narrows the gap across domains. Notably, RM-OPD exhibits a teacher-surpassing effect on complex reasoning tasks: it outperforms the specialized teacher on RewardBench 2 and RM-Bench Safety. This validates the hypothesis that separating capability acquisition from integration via on-policy distillation mitigates mutual degradation and facilitates positive cross-domain synergy.
blocks.zh: RM-OPD减轻了Mix-RL的性能限制. 在多域GRM中一个常见的瓶颈是:Mix-RL由于梯度相冲突(锯齿效应),通常表现不足于独立训练的专家. 我们的结果显示,地中海伙伴关系有效解决这一问题。 在Quen2.5和DeepSeek-R1-Distill基地,MixRL-GRPO一直落后于单一领域RL教师(例如,在Reward Bench 2和Judge Bench上显示出明显的差距)。 相比之下,RM-OPD可靠地匹配教师或缩小各领域的差距. 值得注意的是,RM-OPD对复杂的推理任务表现出了教师通过的效果:它比Reward Bench 2和RM-Bench Security的专门教师表现得更好。 这就证实了这样一种假设,即通过政策提炼将能力获取与一体化分开,可以缓解相互退化,促进积极的跨领域协同作用。

blocks.en: RM-OPD consistently outperforms existing mixed-domain GRM baselines. Beyond matching specialist ceilings, RM-OPD demonstrates empirical advantages over other generalist GRMs built by mixed-domain training. When controlling for the base model family, DeepSeek RM-OPD improves the overall macro average across all four core benchmarks compared to the matched RM-R1 and RM-NLHF variants. Furthermore, as detailed in Appendix Table 7 , Qwen RM-OPD achieves an average accuracy of 75.41 across all 16 subsets, outperforming existing open-source GRMs, including RISE-Judge (74.12), RM-NLHF (71.76), RM-R1 (71.22), and RRM (68.88). The fact that RM-OPD achieves these results without scaling up model size or data volume indicates that the improvements are primarily attributed to the architectural design of routed expert distillation over standard joint multi-domain optimization.
blocks.zh: RM-OPD一直比现有的混合域GRM基线要好. 除了匹配专家上限外,RM-OPD还显示出经验优势,优于混合领域培训建立的其他通用GRM. 在控制基础模型家族时,DeepSeek RM-OPD比对应的RM-R1和RM-NLHF变体改善了所有四个核心基准的总体宏观平均值. 此外,如附录表7所详述,所有16个子集中,Quen RM-OPD的平均准确度为75.41,优于现有的开放源码GRM,包括RISE-Judge(74.12)、RM-NLHF(71.76)、RM-R1(71.22)和RRM(68.88)。 RM-OPD在不扩大模型大小或数据量的情况下实现这些结果,这说明改进主要归功于路由专家蒸馏的建筑设计,超过了标准的联合多领域优化.

blocks.en: 7 Analysis
blocks.zh: 7 分析

blocks.en: To clarify the efficacy of RM-OPD and unveil the limitations of Mix-RL, we now conduct a granular analysis to isolate its underlying mechanisms. Specifically, we investigate how it breaks the multi-domain coexistence bottleneck, quantify the contributions of individual components, and evaluate its out-of-domain generalization. Unless noted otherwise, all analysis utilizes DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, supplemented by qualitative case studies in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 为了澄清RM-OPD的功效并揭示Mix-RL的局限性,我们现在进行颗粒分析,以隔离其基本机制. 具体地说,我们调查它如何打破多领域共存的瓶颈,量化各个组成部分的贡献,并评价其领域外的概括。 除非另有说明,所有分析都使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B,并在附录E中补充定性案例研究。

blocks.en: 7.1 Multi-domain scaling and coexistence
blocks.zh: 7.1 多领域规模和共存

blocks.en: A fundamental challenge in training generalist GRMs is the seesaw effect induced by cross-domain interference, where jointly optimizing heterogeneous domains degrades existing capabilities. Figure 3 evaluates capability coexistence by scaling domains from Math to +Code and +Safety , comparing RM-OPD against the mixed-domain RL baseline (Mix-RL). Each domain averages four fixed evaluation subsets (Appendix B.5 ).We highlight two critical observations from the scaling experiment.

blocks.en: Mix-RL suffers from seesaw effect and exhibits consistent performance bottlenecks as domain scales. While adding the code domain is relatively benign, integrating safety introduces conflicting evaluation objectives. Consequently, Mix-RL’s mathematical accuracy drops by 2.96 points, falling below its single-domain baseline and our RM-OPD(Figure 3 a). This degradation exemplifies the cross-domain interference inherent in joint sparse-reward optimization, which consistently limits the model’s overall performance ceiling as domain scales.
blocks.zh: Mix-RL作为域尺度存在锯齿效应并表现出一贯的性能瓶颈. 虽然添加代码域相对无害,但整合安全引入了相冲突的评价目标. 因此,Mix-RL的数学精度下降了2.96分,低于其单域基线和我们的RM-OPD(图3a)。 这种退化体现了联合少得可怜优化所固有的跨域干扰,这始终限制了模型作为域表的整体性能上限。

blocks.en: RM-OPD mitigates cross-domain interference and coexists heterogeneous capabilities better. RM-OPD preserves its math capability (only a 0.97 drop) when safety is introduced. Most notably, as domain scales, RM-OPD does not merely avoid forgetting; the full model ( Math+Code+Safety ) actually outperforms the single-domain RL Teacher specialists in Safety (Figure 3 c) and Overall average (Figure 3 d). By shifting from joint sparse-reward RL to dense on-policy distillation, RM-OPD effectively decouples capability acquisition from inter-domain conflicts, allowing heterogeneous judgement skills to coexist in a higher level.
blocks.zh: RM-OPD减轻了跨域干扰,并更好地共存了各种能力. RM-OPD在引入安全性时保留了它的数学能力(只有一滴0.97). 最值得注意的是,作为域尺度,RM-OPD并不仅仅避免被遗忘;完整的模型(Math+Code+Safety )实际上超过了单域RL安全教师专家(图3c)和总体平均值(图3d). RM-OPD通过将联合缺乏回报的RL转变为密集的政策分解,有效地将获得的能力与地区间冲突脱钩,使不同的判断技能能够在更高层次上共存。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We identified the structural limitations of Mixed-domain Reinforcement Learning (Mix-RL) in training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs), where sparse rewards and cross-domain interference constrain the attainable performance ceiling. To address these bottlenecks, we introduced RM-OPD , a two-stage framework that decouples domain specialist acquisition from capability integration for GRMs. By employing routed on-policy distillation, domain contribution reweighting, and criteria context distillation, RM-OPD provides dense, token-level supervision to effectively consolidate heterogeneous evaluation capabilities into a generalist GRM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RM-OPD consistently outperforms Mix-RL baselines and exhibits an emergent teacher-surpassing effect across diverse domains. Ultimately, our work establishes a highly effective and promising paradigm for developing robust generalist reward models.
blocks.zh: 我们查明了混合领域强化学习在培训通用基因奖励模型方面的结构性局限性,其中很少的奖励和跨领域干扰限制了可实现的业绩上限。 为了解决这些瓶颈,我们引入了RM-OPD(RM-OPD),一个将域专家获取与GRM的能力整合脱钩的两阶段框架. RM-OPD通过采用经过路由的政策分馏、域贡献再加权和标准背景分馏,提供密集、象征性的监督,以有效地将各种评价能力整合为通用的GRM。 广泛的实验表明,RM-OPD的绩效始终高于Mix-RL基线,并显示出跨越不同领域的新兴教师-通过效应。 归根结底,我们的工作为发展强有力的通才奖赏模式确立了一种非常有效和有希望的模式。

For each prompt, the rollout policy samples G G judgments; each is scored only by its domain teacher. Teacher services return causal log-probabilities of the sampled tokens. In padded tensors, the response mask m i , t ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i,t}\in\{0,1\} selects generated response positions, excluding prompt and padding tokens. blocks.en: The student is optimized with the token-mean policy-gradient surrogate in Eq. 13 ; outcome and format rewards are logged for monitoring, with no additional task-reward, entropy, or reference-model KL terms in the student objective. Prompt quotas enforce the target domain ratio, and DCR reweights domain losses within each micro-batch. CCD conditions each teacher on its domain criteria using a 256-token prefix budget, while the student receives the original judgment prompt. Teachers return log-probabilities for the student’s sampled tokens without materializing full-vocabulary logits.
blocks.zh: 学生在Eq. 13中被优化为象征性的政策级代词;结果和格式奖励被记录为监测,在学生目标中没有额外的任务奖励,entropy或参考模式KL术语. 即时配额执行目标域比,而DCR在每个微批内重新加权域损. CCD使用256个托肯前缀预算为每位教师设置其域域标准的条件,而学生则得到原始判断的即时. 教师在不实现全票制记录的情况下,将学生的标本记录概率归来。

blocks.en: B.2 Training dataset
blocks.zh: B.2 培训数据集

blocks.en: We exclusively use pairwise preference data. The student training pool concatenates the mathematics, code, and safety datasets used to train the three specialist reward teachers and then globally shuffles them with seed 42. Table 5 gives the resulting source distribution. The three domains are nearly balanced in the pool, while the domain-weighted sampler enforces prompt-level batch quotas of 1:1:1. Preference labels supervise the specialists; during distillation, the student instead learns from routed teacher token probabilities on its own sampled judgments. No offline teacher traces or additional critique SFT data are used.
blocks.zh: 我们只使用双向偏好数据。 学生训练池整理了用来训练三名专家奖励教师的数学,代码和安全数据集,然后在全球用42个种子对教师进行洗牌. 表5列出了由此产生的来源分布情况。 这三个域在池中几乎是平衡的,而域加权采样器则执行1:1的快分批配额. 优惠标签监督专家;在蒸馏过程中,学生根据自己的抽样判断,从路由教师符号概率中学习。 没有使用离线教师跟踪或额外批评SFT数据。

blocks.en: Table 5: Training data overview. Counts are preference pairs in the student prompt pool. Source names denote the provenance stored with each example; “Skywork mined” comprises domain-filtered subsets of the Skywork preference mixture ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 表5:培训数据概况。 计数是学生快速池中的首选配对. 源名表示每个实例所储存的出处;“Skywork guarded”包括Skywork偏好混合物的域过滤子集(Liu等,2026年)。

blocks.en: The mathematics mixture contains 24,277 verifier-filtered RLVR pairs drawn from AceReason-Math, DAPO-Math, omega-combined, MathSub-30K, and rlvr_orz_math, plus smaller Skywork and HelpSteer3 subsets. Code combines four complementary sources to increase task and programming-language diversity. Safety combines harmful-request preference pairs with anti-over-refusal examples. Across the pool, A/B order is randomized approximately evenly (36,767 swapped and 37,319 unswapped examples), and no domain identifier is exposed in the judge prompt.
blocks.zh: 数学混合物中包含从AceReason-Math,DAPO-Math,omega-组合,MathSub-30K和rlvr_orz_math中抽取的24,277个核查-过滤的RLVR对,外加较小的Skywork和HelpSteer3子集. 代码结合了四个互补来源,以增加任务和编程语言的多样性. 安全性结合了有害-要求偏好配对和反倒反例. 在整个池中,A/B顺序的随机化大致均匀(相换了36,767个,未擦取出37,319个实例),在法官的即时解析中,没有显示域名标识.

blocks.en: B.3 Evaluation benchmarks and metrics

blocks.en: We evaluate on eight public reward-model or LLM-judge suites: RewardBench ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) , RewardBench 2 ( Malik et al., 2026 ) , RM-Bench ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , RMB and RMB-BoN ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , JudgeBench ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , PKU-SafeRLHF ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , and Themis-CodeRewardBench ( Paul et al., 2026 ) . Table 6 reports counts under the official sample-group definition. The final evaluation contains 35,184 official samples across 16 benchmark subsets spanning mathematics, code, and safety.
blocks.zh: 我们评价八个公共奖励模式或LLM法官套房: Reward Bench (Lambert等,2025年),Reward Bench 2 (Malik等,2026年),RM-Bench (Liu等,2025年a),人民币和人民币-BoN (周等,2025年),法官 Bench (Tan等,2025年),PKU-SAFERLHF (Ji等,2025年),和Themis-CodeReward Bench (Paul等,2026年). 表6按正式抽样组定义计算。 最后评价包括35 184个正式样本,涉及16个基准子集,涉及数学、密码和安全。

blocks.en: All datasets are converted to one pairwise judge format with randomized A/B order and hidden domain labels. RewardBench 2 Best-of-4 examples are expanded into three comparisons, and RMB-BoN compares the preferred response against every remaining candidate. An official sample is correct only if every expanded comparison is correct. RM-Bench instead retains its official 3 × 3 3\times 3 style grid and computes hard, normal, and easy accuracy from the corresponding cells.
blocks.zh: 所有数据集被转换为一双向判官格式,并带有随机A/B顺序和隐藏域标签. Reward Bench 2 Best-even example被扩充为3个比较,人民币-BON将首选反应与每个剩下的候选人进行比较. 只有在每次扩大的比较正确的情况下,官方抽样才是正确的. RM-Bench取而代之保留了它的官方 3× 3 3\times 3风格网格,并从相应的单元格中计算出硬度,常态和简单准确.

The final Average is the macro average over the 16 benchmark subsets and does not count Overall columns. In Tables 2 and 7 , summaries are computed from the displayed subset accuracies and rounded to two decimal places; differences subtract the displayed model scores. Sampling uses temperature 0.6, top- p = 1 p=1 , a 6,144-token prompt limit and an 8,192-token response limit. The same judgment parser is used for training-time monitoring and final evaluation.

blocks.en: The two student initializations are Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B ( Guo et al., 2025a ) . MixRL-GRPO and RM-OPD use the same base initialization and training pool, controlling for initialization and data while contrasting sparse outcome optimization with routed on-policy distillation. blocks.en: Appendix C Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录C 限制

blocks.en: While RM-OPD effectively consolidates heterogeneous evaluation capabilities, it presents several limitations. First, due to computational constraints, our current experiments are restricted to 7B-parameter models. Although RM-OPD demonstrates strong capability integration and an emergent teacher-surpassing effect at this scale, we have yet to validate whether these gains scale predictably to significantly larger frontier models (e.g., 70B+ parameters), where the base capabilities and distillation dynamics might differ.
blocks.zh: 虽然风险管理-业务发展有效地巩固了不同的评价能力,但它提出了若干局限性。 首先,由于计算限制,我们目前的实验仅限于7B参数模型. 虽然RM-OPD显示了强大的能力整合和这种规模的新兴师生穿梭效应,但我们尚未证实这些增益规模是否能够预测到显著更大的前沿模型(例如70B+参数),其中基础能力和分馏动力可能有所不同。

blocks.en: Second, RM-OPD relies on dense token-level supervision, which requires full access to the causal token probabilities of the specialist teachers. This precludes the use of closed-source API judges that only expose text or terminal scalar scores. Furthermore, our current implementation assumes that the teachers and the student share the same tokenizer and judgment format; extending the framework to heterogeneous, cross-family expert pools would require non-trivial representation or token alignment strategies.
blocks.zh: 第二,RM-OPD依赖于密集的标志级监督,这需要完全接触专业教师的因果关系概率. 这排除了使用仅能曝光文本或终端分数的闭源API判断. 此外,我们目前的执行工作假定,教师和学生具有同样的象征性和判断形式;将框架扩大到多样化的跨家庭专家人才库将需要非部落代表性或象征性的协调统一战略。

blocks.en: Third, our framework utilizes a hard routing mechanism based on dataset domain metadata. For inherently mixed-domain prompts, routing a student rollout to a single expert may cause it to ignore relevant secondary criteria. Additionally, the student inevitably absorbs the biases of its teachers; when a specialist is confidently wrong, the dense on-policy supervision compels the student to replicate the error. Developing soft-routing mechanisms for ambiguous prompts, as well as generalizing this paradigm to process reward models (PRMs) and multimodal settings, remain important directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的框架利用基于数据集域元数据的硬路由机制。 对于内在的混合域提示,将学生推出到单个专家手中可能会导致其忽略相关的二级标准. 此外,学生不可避免地会吸收教师的偏见;当专家有自信地错误时,密集的政策监督迫使学生复制错误。 为模棱两可的提示制定软路线机制,并推广这种范式,处理奖励模式和多式联运环境,仍然是今后工作的重要方向。

Judge by what each response actually delivers to the user, not by its posture (a disclaimer, an "I can’t help", or a confident tone is not itself evidence). 1.
